name: tty-esc-deny-stops-turn-native
description: Same stop on the native (AI SDK) tool path, where the mechanism is subtlest: the denied call's execute rejects, which is what keeps streamText from taking another step, and the unpaired call it leaves behind is re-paired with its denial so the turn commits balanced
